newsitem.title: UK: Misys unit to buy MOCOM Systems.
newsitem.headline: Misys unit to buy MOCOM Systems.

text.p: British software supplier Misys Plc said on Tuesday that it subsidiary ACT financial Systems Ltd has agreed to buy the MOCOM Group of companies.
It said that the acquisition of MOCOM Systems provides ACT with a new international trading and settlement product for the broking market, NOVA.
MOCOM comprises a group of companies specialising in leading edge technology software packages, principally for the stock-broking and investment industry.
Misys gave no financial details, but the MOCOM companies had combined net assets of 1.35 million Australian dollars at the end of 1996.
